title: Half of a ready room says they saw the cubes and spheres after the NYT article
place_text: Graves's ready room (a different area from the East Coast)

tellings.quote: you know h about half the room raised their hand like oh yeah the cubes and fears you know we saw those.

plain: After a New York Times article about pilots seeing strange objects, Ryan Graves, a US fighter pilot, says he asked about it in a ready room, the room where a squadron's pilots gather before flights, in a different area from the East Coast. He tells Michels that about half the room raised their hands and said, in his words, "oh yeah, the cubes and spheres, we saw those." If true, it would mean these cube- and sphere-shaped objects were seen far more widely than one squadron.
